# Upstream source and adaptation

Source: [docker/skills](https://github.com/docker/skills)

Source path: `skills/docker-compose-patterns`

The detailed references, checks, assets, and scripts were copied from the
checked-out source in `HOME_SERVER/skills` and retained as supporting material.
The local `SKILL.md` keeps the useful Compose guidance and adds HOME_SERVER

The upstream skill declares Apache-2.0 licensing. Preserve attribution and
review license obligations before redistributing this repository.
